verdict.rationale: Session replay is a fair axis for a web and app analytics product, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows GA4 recording sessions or linking funnel drop-offs or error events to replays. The pack covers only funnel reporting via the Data API, BigQuery export and other reporting features, none of which deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users
